title: libgrpc_csharp_ext.x64.dylib not found (.net core 2 preview 2)

labels.name: Bug
labels.description: A fault in an existing feature

body:
Please read https://github.com/GoogleCloudPlatform/google-cloud-dotnet/issues/1205

Everything works with these dependencies:
```
<ItemGroup>
  <PackageReference Include="Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk" Version="15.3.0-preview-20170517-02" />
  <PackageReference Include="xunit" Version="2.2.0" />
  <PackageReference Include="xunit.runner.visualstudio" Version="2.2.0" />
  <PackageReference Include="Grpc.Core" Version="1.4.1" />
</ItemGroup>
```

but it does not anymore when we use `<PackageReference Include="xunit" Version="2.3.0-beta*" />`

final error:
```
System.IO.FileNotFoundException : Error loading native library. Not found in any of the possible locations: /Users/jdelfour/code/UCP/UDL-API/ihs/test/IntegrationTests/bin/Debug/netcoreapp2.0/libgrpc_csharp_ext.x64.dylib,/Users/jdelfour/code/UCP/UDL-API/ihs/test/IntegrationTests/bin/Debug/netcoreapp2.0/runtimes/osx/native/libgrpc_csharp_ext.x64.dylib,/Users/jdelfour/code/UCP/UDL-API/ihs/test/IntegrationTests/bin/Debug/netcoreapp2.0/../../runtimes/osx/native/libgrpc_csharp_ext.x64.dylib
```
